rollups.text: Digital-marketing education and career planning: On 2023-07-21, the user compared online and in-person study and considered SEO/content-focused versus broad digital-marketing certifications, with goals of improving skills and competitiveness. The user decided to pursue the Digital Marketing Institute’s Digital Marketing Certified Associate (DMCA) and asked about registration, but later chose Google Digital Garage as a free broad foundation, with HubSpot Inbound Marketing Certification as a possible next step. The user also compared HubSpot with DMI, noting HubSpot was free and DMI cost about $5,000, and asked about recognition, financing, and career support. In a separate comparison with the American Marketing Association’s Certified Digital Marketing Professional (CDMP), the user leaned toward DMI to advance in their current role but remained undecided about cost and study time. By 2023-07-21, the user was considering 5–6 study hours weekly, preferably on two weekend mornings, and allowing 3–4 months plus buffer time for DMCA; no final schedule adoption was recorded.

Charity running and participation: By 2023-07-21, the user had volunteered at a local Walk for a Cure, setting up registration and distributing water; the user enjoyed the community and wanted to join more charity runs or walks. The user considered beginning with a 5K, having completed several charity walks and not feeling ready for a marathon, and planned to find beginner training resources, events, and running groups. The user also planned to ask colleague Rachel, met at Walk for a Cure, to run together. Separately, the user completed a 5K charity run on 2022-03-19 in a personal-best 27:12 and a 10K trail run on 2023-04-03 in 1:10; on 2023-07-21 the user sought a flatter route for the next 10K and considered Brooks Ghost shoes for continued running.

Running and cycling milestones: 5K charity run completed on 2022-03-19 in 27 minutes 12 seconds (personal best); 10K trail run completed on 2023-04-03 in 1 hour 10 minutes, on hilly and muddy terrain; 30-mile bike ride completed on 2023-04-17 at an average of 18 mph.

Digital marketing agency materials: On 2023-07-21, the user planned to promote a new business through blog posts and social-media content. The user asked about tools, content choices, and social promotion, then sought lead-generation tactics and free prospect resources. The user requested small-business marketing blog topics, a prospecting email and needs-and-budget survey, and an onboarding email sequence for new clients. No business type, audience, agency name, or platform was specified.

Children’s family-history journal: On 2023-07-21, while learning Procreate and looking for a children’s journal concept, the user rejected several initial ideas and developed a family-history journal. The user considered a chapter sequence covering ancestors and origins, past generations, relatives growing up, recent family history, and traditions and culture. The user then sought a more playful title, after considering options such as “Our Family Tree” and “The Story of Us”; suggested playful possibilities included “Our Family Safari” and “Our Family’s Superheroes.” No completed journal or final title was reported.

Bathroom cleaning and organization: On 2023-07-19, the user spent an extra 30 minutes cleaning and putting things in order and felt it made a real difference. For the weekend of 2023-07-22–2023-07-23, the user planned to clean the shower and bathtub while avoiding harsh chemicals and to organize bathroom cabinets. The user was interested in a baking-soda-and-vinegar paste and wicker or rattan baskets; completion of the weekend plan was not recorded.

Autocross and track driving: By 2023-07-21, the user had participated in autocross for several months and used a data logger to identify driving improvements. The user completed a first proper-track amateur drifting experience at Sonoma Raceway during Turbocharged Weekend on 2023-07-01–2023-07-02, driving a modified 2015 Nissan GT-R; the user was nervous but enjoyed it, completed three laps, spun at a tight-apex turn on lap two, recovered, and noted worn rear tires. The user had replaced brake pads beforehand and later installed coilovers, was considering wheels and a broader aero kit, and planned more events and track days. The user uses a Traqmate logger and its software, is open to alternatives, and was especially interested in optimizing suspension and braking. No wheel or aero-kit purchase was reported.

Shoes and footwear mentioned: old Adidas running shoes, which the user planned to track and replace (2023-07-21); red high heels that the user planned to return because they did not fit properly (2023-07-21); new black-and-white sneakers worn to the user’s niece’s birthday party, where they drew compliments (date unspecified); H&M distressed denim jeans purchased for $39.99 and Sam Edelman black ankle boots, planned for a brunch outfit with an Everlane cashmere-blend cardigan (2023-07-21); black leather Zara boots, purchased recently by 2023-07-21 and worn with a grey sweater and dark jeans to brunch on 2023-01-22, receiving compliments; brown loafers polished and worn to work on 2023-01-10, also receiving compliments; wedding sandals tried at Nordstrom on 2023-07-15–2023-07-16 for $90, with purchase undecided as of 2023-07-21; Brooks Ghost running shoes considered on 2023-07-21, with no color or size selected.

Cooking and food experiences: The user ordered Spaghetti Bolognese from Bella Vita on 2023-07-14 and found it only okay because the pasta was overcooked and the sauce too sweet. The user made chicken fajitas with a cast-iron skillet on 2023-07-05; the skillet heated well, and the user planned another fajita dinner on 2023-07-21 with bell peppers, onions, optional jalapeños or serranos, flour tortillas, sour cream, salsa, and a smoky tomato-chipotle salsa. On 2023-07-06 the user loved spicy pork bibimbap from a new downtown Korean restaurant. At a neighbor’s barbecue on 2023-07-15–2023-07-16, the user ate two helpings of baby back ribs and planned to try rib recipes, rubs, and sauces. On 2023-07-21 the user planned a ground-beef one-pot pasta and red pepper flakes, hoping it would improve on the recent mediocre pasta.

Luna’s activities and care: On 2023-07-21, the user said Luna’s veterinarian described Luna as a bit chunky and the user was concerned about her weight. The user wanted to make homemade sweet-potato chews and transition Luna from regular treats to the new chews, potentially using them as rewards during play. Luna loves climbing her cat tree, uses the small hammock at its top to curl up and relax, and gets defensive when the user tries to clean the tree or rearrange it; the user had set it up a few weeks earlier.

The user completed at least three timed endurance events specifically recorded here: one 5K charity run on 2022-03-19 (27:12, personal best), one 10K trail run on 2023-04-03 (1:10), and one 30-mile bike ride on 2023-04-17 (18 mph average). These are three distinct recorded events, not a count of all the user’s runs or rides.

Salsa dancing: On 2023-07-15–2023-07-16, the user attended a salsa social, met new people, and danced with Alex for nearly an hour, feeling comfortable following his lead. By 2023-07-21, the user wanted to find local events and planned to ask Alex to practice together. The user also wanted to improve leading and following, hip and leg mobility, and upper-body relaxation because their shoulders tend to tense while dancing; the user planned to incorporate stretches and exercises, especially shoulder rolls and chest stretches, into a daily routine. Whether the user contacted Alex or maintained the routine is not recorded.

Charity-event planning: On 2023-07-21, the user was planning a charity event for a few months later and considered holding it in January or February, preferring a new and distinctive event. The user chose to start with a themed January charity run/walk and costume contest, planned a prize for the best group costume, and planned another prize for the most creative fundraising idea. The user sought ways to attract participants and ideas for winter costumes, group costumes, and fundraising activities. No event date or completion was reported.
